policy: Only dependencies with a verified upstream, immutable version, checksum, and compatible license may enter a release lockfile.

allowlist.name: FXServer
allowlist.notes: Downloaded by the operator. Requires an operator-owned Cfx license key.

allowlist.name: oxmysql
allowlist.notes: Pin an official release and checksum after legal review.

allowlist.name: ox_lib
allowlist.notes: Optional adapter dependency; never call undocumented internals.

allowlist.name: ox_inventory
allowlist.notes: Install separately from the official release. Adapter licensing requires legal review.

prohibited: real-world branded vehicles or unlicensed third-party IP
dependencies without an explicit redistribution grant
